instruction.name: xvftintrm.l.d
instruction.description: Convert double-precision floating point elements in `a` to signed 64-bit integer, rounding towards negative infinity.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 3.99; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvftintrm.l.d $xr0, $xr8; xvftintrm.l.d $xr1, $xr9; xvftintrm.l.d $xr2, $xr10; xvftintrm.l.d $xr3, $xr11; xvftintrm.l.d $xr4, $xr12; xvftintrm.l.d $xr5, $xr13; xvftintrm.l.d $xr6, $xr14; xvftintrm.l.d $xr7, $xr15
